setupCues: Place your hands approximately under your shoulders.
Brace in a straight line from shoulders to heels.
movementCues: Lower your body with control, pause, then press the floor away.
Inhale as you lower. Exhale as you press.

encouragement: Keep your body in one straight line.
phrases.correctiveForm: On the next set, try keeping your hips in line with your shoulders.
phrases.uncertainForm: I could not get a clear enough side view to evaluate your body alignment.

camera.guidance: Position the camera at the side and keep the shoulders, hips, and ankles visible throughout the movement. Avoid major landmark occlusion.
